responses.text: {Player not in NCR gear} I'm not supposed to let civilians just walk around this place. There better be a good reason for you being here.
{Player in NCR gear} I'm pretty sure you're not authorized to be here, whatever unit you happen to be from. What do you want?
Very well. You can tell Reyes that this station is secure.

topics.prompt: I've brought radio security code updates from Sergeant Reyes at Camp Forlorn Hope.

responses.text: I'm in charge of the radio - hence the title "Comm Officer." I'd much rather be out on patrol, since nothing much happens around here.
Well, when there's trouble regular NCR troops can't handle, they send in a Ranger. Problem solved.
We're also responsible for keeping the borders of the NCR secure, scouting out threats, that sort of thing.

topics.prompt: I'd like to know more about the Rangers.
